# Mūt, translated into industries: what the archetype actually does
Every age hires the same gods; only the job titles change. **Mūt** never stopped working.

Mōt's mythology is the dark season of the year made personal. His stories are preserved in the Baꜥal Cycle, where he confronts Baꜥal, kills him, and is in turn destroyed and reborn in a cycle that explains drought, death, and the return of fertility.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Mūt
- **Pantheon:** Phoenician
- **Domain of influence:** Death, Underworld
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Society & Spirit · Energy & Natural World · Culture & Entertainment
- **Strongest seat:** Funerary & Memorial Services
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 159 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Summons.** In KTU 1. 4 vii–viii, Mōt sends word to Baꜥal: because he was not invited to the storm-god's feast, he will feast on Baꜥal himself. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

**The Descent and Death.** In KTU 1. 5, Baꜥal submits. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Funerary & Memorial Services

*Funeral care, memorials, and legacy services. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*Death itself in the Ugaritic cycle.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Agriculture, Food & Harvest

*Farming, grain, food production, and agtech. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The dry season personified; his grip on Baꜥal is the drought the harvest fears.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Gaming, Fantasy & Entertainment IP

*Video games, streaming franchises, and fantasy worlds. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Modern fantasy and games cast him as the Canaanite lord of the underworld; death with a throne.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Astrology, Tarot & Esoteric Services

*Astrology apps, tarot, and spiritual guidance. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Neopagan reconstruction keeps his throne; the underworld’s Canaanite lord in modern practice.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Mōt's mythology is the dark season of the year made personal. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in funerary & memorial services, agriculture, food & harvest, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/mot/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
